selection_approach_display.default: Plymouth checks academic and route eligibility before applying the UCAT or GAMSAT requirement for the applicant's route.

by_applicant_pool.home_a100: Plymouth checks academic eligibility, then uses UCAT as the shortlisting metric within the Home A100 pool.
by_applicant_pool.ukwpmed_widening_access_a100: Plymouth checks academic and widening-access eligibility, then uses UCAT as the shortlisting metric for the UKWPMED/Widening Access route.
by_applicant_pool.international_a100: Plymouth checks academic and English-language eligibility, then uses UCAT as the shortlisting metric within the International A100 pool.

course.name: BMBS Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery
course.notes: Standard-entry BMBS A100. A102 Foundation/Gateway is a separate course and applicant pool. Graduates may apply through A100 only when they satisfy the published academic requirements or a GAMSAT route that remains manual review in ApplySmart.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Eligible Home, Scottish and Rest of UK applicants are assessed in the combined Home pool.
Eligible International applicants are assessed in a separate pool for a small international quota.
UKWPMED and Widening Access applicants remain in the A100 contextual/widening-access pathway with separate historical UCAT thresholds; A102 is a separate course.
GAMSAT thresholds are recorded as historical context only. ApplySmart does not automate Plymouth GAMSAT route eligibility or ranking in this frozen architecture implementation.

overall_policy.description: Plymouth checks academic and route eligibility first. GCSEs and post-16 qualifications are eligibility gates, not scored ranking inputs. UCAT is then used as annual, pool-specific interview-shortlisting guidance.
not_eligible_if: The applicable GCSE, A-level, IB or Scottish Advanced Higher minimum is not met.
A current-cycle UCAT cognitive total is not supplied for the UCAT route.
An English science A-level practical endorsement is required but not confirmed.
An International applicant does not satisfy IELTS 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in Speaking and Listening or an accepted exemption.

gcse.sitting_policy: GCSE resits are considered subject to Plymouth's admissions policy.
gcse.notes: GCSEs are threshold-only. Plymouth does not publish a GCSE points-scoring model for interview shortlisting.

ukwpmed_offer.notes: UKWPMED requires A in Biology and B in a second science in the supplied research.

a_level.notes: Plymouth accepts an A*AA-AAB range; ApplySmart implements the evidenced standard A*AA route plus contextual AAB and UKWPMED ABB routes. Academics are not converted into interview-shortlisting points.

ib.notes: IB requires 36-38 points overall, including HL 6 in Biology and HL 6 in one further accepted science. Contextual IB reductions are not explicit enough for automation.

scottish.notes: Scottish Highers alone are not accepted; Scottish/RUK applicants map to the Home pool once Advanced Higher requirements are met.

degree.notes: External graduates cannot use a previous degree as an A100 academic qualification. Internal Biomedical/Medical Sciences transfer and GAMSAT route handling are manual review in ApplySmart.

international_qualification.notes: Country-specific qualification equivalence must be verified by Plymouth or institution-specific evidence.

blocked_routes.reason: A102 is a separate course and applicant pool.

manual_review_routes: Internal Biomedical Sciences or Medical Sciences transfer route
External graduate applicants without verified A-level-equivalent academic route
post_16.notes: Academic qualifications are threshold-only and carry 0% weighting after eligibility is met.

ucat.threshold_policy: UCAT thresholds are determined annually by application number and quality in separate applicant pools.

sjt.notes: The Admissions Advisory Panel reserves the right to consider all UCAT aspects, including SJT, but no explicit SJT band exclusion is published.

other_tests.name: GAMSAT
other_tests.used_for: Applicants who do not hold suitable A-levels, including some graduates.
other_tests.notes: Historical GAMSAT thresholds are recorded separately. ApplySmart does not automate this route without a safe shared eligibility model.

conditions: A-level resit applicants not meeting widening access policy must have achieved at least ABB in the first attempt and be predicted AAA in the resit attempt.
A suitable qualification profile must be achieved on the first resit attempt.
Full A-levels, including resits, must be completed within a maximum of three years of study.

adjustments: Reduced A-level academic offer of AAB for Widening Access applicants.
Reduced A-level academic offer of ABB for UKWPMED applicants.
Separate historical UCAT thresholds exist for UKWPMED/Widening Access applicants.
contextual.notes: Contextual support changes academic offer and historical UCAT guidance. It is not implemented as an academic points uplift.

exemptions: GCSE or IGCSE English Language grade 4/C or above where accepted
IB English evidence meeting Plymouth requirements
english_language.notes: International applicants must prove English proficiency unless an accepted exemption is verified.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Professional checks are post-offer requirements and do not affect interview prediction.

non_academic.notes: Personal statement and work experience are not used to shortlist for interview in the supplied research.

ranking_factors.notes: Academics are checked as eligibility gates and are not converted into an interview-shortlisting points score.
UCAT thresholds vary annually by applicant pool. Historical thresholds are guidance only.

total_score.calculation_method: No verified academic component score exists. Use current-cycle UCAT total only as the ranking metric when a supported UCAT applicant is otherwise eligible.
total_score.notes: Historical 3600-scale UCAT values are stored separately from executable runtime guidance.

calculation.notes: Academic requirements are checked as eligibility gates. ApplySmart then applies fixed pool-specific historical-normalised UCAT guidance bands calibrated from Plymouth official 2023-2025 historical thresholds.

thresholds.notes: Median of Home normalised historical thresholds 1657.5, 1950 and 2010.
Median of International normalised historical thresholds 1830, 1950 and 2002.5.
Median of UKWPMED/Widening Access normalised historical thresholds 1657.5, 1747.5 and 1905. Runtime lower boundaries are rounded upward where needed.
No verified current-cycle /2700 Plymouth UCAT threshold exists. Converted historical values must not be copied into executable band rules.

effect.value: AAB Widening Access or ABB UKWPMED, with separate historical UCAT threshold rows.

selection_adjustments.notes: Plymouth Widening Access contextual eligibility uses the official 5-point contextual-marker threshold. Academic grades themselves are not converted into interview-shortlisting points.

quotas_or_pools: Home, Scottish and RUK applicants map to the combined Home pool.
International applicants are assessed in a separate pool.
UKWPMED/Widening Access applicants have separate historical UCAT thresholds.
GAMSAT applicants have separate historical GAMSAT thresholds but remain manual review in ApplySmart.

output_band_policy.notes: Supported UCAT-route applicants receive ApplySmart historical-normalised guidance bands. GAMSAT and unsupported routes remain manual review or insufficient_evidence.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Selection for interview is threshold-based and annually variable. ApplySmart uses approved historical-normalised guidance bands for supported UCAT applicant pools; these are estimates, not official Plymouth current cutoffs.

criteria.description: UKWPMED participants may receive the ABB route where verified.

contextual_admissions.notes: A102 Foundation/Gateway widening-access admissions are a separate course and are not implemented in this A100 profile.

contextual_eligibility.notes: Plymouth A100 contextual eligibility is determined from the redesigned Step 6 profile. Legacy contextual flags do not independently activate this route.

ranking_pools.name: Home A100 UCAT pool
ranking_pools.notes: Home, Scottish and RUK applicants are ranked together after academic eligibility.

ranking_pools.name: International A100 UCAT pool
ranking_pools.notes: International applicants are ranked separately after academic eligibility.

ranking_pools.name: UKWPMED/Widening Access A100 UCAT guidance pool
ranking_pools.notes: Separate historical UCAT thresholds exist, but no fixed current /2700 threshold is published.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.
Maximum fundable Home limit for the 2025-2026 intake in the supplied research.
Maximum fundable International limit for the 2025-2026 intake in the supplied research.

interview_format.notes: MMI evidence is retained for transparency only; ApplySmart does not predict offers.

interview_scoring.notes: Interview outcomes use numerical station scores and red-flag assessments; detailed offer thresholds are not published.

tie_breakers: Interview numerical score and red-flag assessments
offer_selection.waiting_list_policy: No official reserve list policy is published in the supplied research.
offer_selection.standard_offer: A*AA-AAB including A in Biology and A in a second accepted science for the standard A-level route represented by ApplySmart.
offer_selection.contextual_offer: AAB for Widening Access and ABB for UKWPMED where verified.
offer_selection.notes: Offer prediction is permanently out of scope.

historical_admissions.notes: Official historical UCAT thresholds remain preserved on the /3600 scale. ApplySmart-derived /2700 values are labelled as non-official historical-normalised calibration evidence for fixed guidance bands.
historical_admissions.warning: Historical Plymouth UCAT thresholds were published on the previous 3600-point cognitive scale. ApplySmart normalises them to the current 2700-point scale for guidance-band calibration only; Plymouth did not publish the converted values, median references or guidance bands.

cycles.conversion_method: official_score_3600 * 3 / 4; exact ApplySmart-derived display equivalent retained because no repository-wide rounding rule is established

sources.title: Plymouth BMBS A100 Research Document supplied for ApplySmart production implementation
sources.notes: User-supplied authoritative research document: /Users/faizan/Desktop/medical university research/playmouth.docx

known_unknowns: No official current-cycle Plymouth /2700 UCAT threshold is published; ApplySmart guidance is derived from historical-normalised evidence only.
No verified academic points-scoring model exists for Plymouth interview shortlisting; academics remain eligibility gates.
GAMSAT route eligibility and ranking cannot be safely automated within this implementation.
validation.review_notes: Plymouth is implemented as academic eligibility plus pool-specific ApplySmart historical-normalised UCAT guidance for supported UCAT routes. The guidance is non-deterministic and not an official Plymouth threshold.

engine_assumptions: Scottish and Rest of UK applicants map to the Home pool, as stated in the supplied research.
Raw historical /3600 UCAT rows are preserved as official historical values and never used directly in runtime comparison.
ApplySmart-derived /2700 medians and fixed /2700 band boundaries are used for supported UCAT-route guidance.
GAMSAT applicants require manual review or insufficient-evidence handling.
do_not_infer: Do not create an academic component score.
Do not compare current applicant /2700 UCAT scores directly with official historical /3600 scores.
Do not treat ApplySmart converted /2700 equivalents, medians or bands as official Plymouth thresholds.
Do not use historical guidance as a guaranteed future cutoff.
manual_review_boundaries: Contextual eligibility evidence not externally verified.
Resit sequences beyond the represented first-resit route.
